fact: The World Bank reports three interagency information-sharing protocols signed by the Agency for Social Protection, against a baseline of zero in July 2019 and a target of three, with the social registry still at 0% of the 60% beneficiary target (pending the ASP MIS) as at 30 May 2025.

Seychelles Nation reports the Agency for Social Protection's ASP Connect system, launched internally on 15 October 2025, is accessible through the SeyID portal; the free text names no data exchanged with the ID, a payment provider or another programme.
